<meta name="claude:viewport-fit-sides" content="cover">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo:wght@500;700;800;900&family=Source+Sans+3:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;0,700;1,400&display=swap">
<style>
/* Layout: full-bleed photo bands, left-aligned type, RWI blue accent + working green; documents and numbers do the selling. */
:root{
  --bg:#f6f7f5; --bg2:#ffffff; --ink:#15211d; --ink2:#4b5a54; --line:#d9dfdb;
  --blue:#1e99d6; --blue-ink:#0f6c9a; --green:#3b8a3f; --green-ink:#2b6b2f; --warn:#ffd54a;
  --dark:#0e1a16; --dark2:#162621; --dark-ink:#e8eee9; --dark-ink2:#a9b8b0;
  --display:"Archivo",system-ui,sans-serif; --body:"Source Sans 3","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;
  --gutter:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px)); --gutter-r:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px));
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#0e1a16;--bg2:#162621;--ink:#e8eee9;--ink2:#a9b8b0;--line:#2a3a34;--blue:#49b4e8;--blue-ink:#8fd2f3;--green:#5fb463;--green-ink:#9ad99d;color-scheme:dark}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#0e1a16;--bg2:#162621;--ink:#e8eee9;--ink2:#a9b8b0;--line:#2a3a34;--blue:#49b4e8;--blue-ink:#8fd2f3;--green:#5fb463;--green-ink:#9ad99d;color-scheme:dark}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--body);font-size:17px;line-height:1.55}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;height:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:10;background:var(--dark)}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}
a{color:var(--blue-ink)}
h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:var(--display);line-height:1.06;text-wrap:balance;margin:0}
h1{font-size:clamp(2.3rem,5.8vw,4.4rem);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.025em}
h2{font-size:clamp(1.75rem,3.4vw,2.7rem);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em}
h3{font-size:1.28rem;font-weight:700}
p{margin:0}
.wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding-left:var(--gutter);padding-right:var(--gutter-r)}
.eyebrow{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--green-ink)}
.band{padding-block:clamp(48px,7vw,96px)}
.band.alt{background:var(--bg2)}
.band.dark{background:var(--dark);color:var(--dark-ink)}
.band.dark .eyebrow{color:var(--green)}
.band.dark p,.band.dark li{color:var(--dark-ink2)}
.band.dark h2,.band.dark h3{color:#fff}
.lead{font-size:1.2rem;max-width:64ch;color:var(--ink2)}
.band.dark .lead{color:var(--dark-ink2)}
.stack{display:grid;gap:18px}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700;font-size:.95rem;letter-spacing:.02em;padding:13px 20px;border-radius:4px;text-decoration:none;border:2px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .12s ease;background:none;color:inherit}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}
.btn:focus-visible,a:focus-visible,button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue);outline-offset:3px}
.btn.primary{background:var(--blue);color:#fff}
.btn.ghost{border-color:currentColor}
.btn.green{background:var(--green);color:#fff}
.draft{background:var(--warn);color:#1a1a1a;font-family:var(--display);font-size:.82rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;text-align:center;padding:7px var(--gutter);display:flex;gap:16px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}
.draft button{font:inherit;background:#1a1a1a;color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:3px;padding:3px 9px;cursor:pointer}
.notes{display:none;background:#fff8dc;color:#1a1a1a;border-bottom:3px solid var(--warn);padding:14px var(--gutter);font-size:.92rem}
.notes.on{display:block}
.notes ul{margin:6px 0 0;padding-left:20px;columns:2;gap:30px}
@media (max-width:760px){.notes ul{columns:1}}
/* header */
header{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:9;background:var(--dark);color:var(--dark-ink);border-bottom:1px solid #223129}
.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;min-height:64px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-decoration:none;color:inherit;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:1.15rem;letter-spacing:-.01em;margin-right:auto}
.brand{flex:none}
.brand .logo{height:50px;width:auto;max-width:none;aspect-ratio:300/148;object-fit:contain;flex:none;display:block}
@media (max-width:1020px){.brand .logo{height:42px}}
footer .brand .logo{height:56px}
.links{display:flex;gap:2px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.links a{color:var(--dark-ink);text-decoration:none;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:500;font-size:.9rem;padding:8px 9px;border-radius:4px}
.links a:hover,.links a[aria-current="page"]{background:#1f2f29;color:#fff}
.links a.q-link{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;font-weight:700}
.phone{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700;color:#fff;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap}
.menu-btn{display:none;background:none;border:1px solid #3a4a44;color:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:8px 10px;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700}
@media (max-width:1020px){.links{display:none;width:100%;flex-direction:column;padding-bottom:10px}.links.open{display:flex}.menu-btn{display:inline-block}.nav{flex-wrap:wrap}.phone{display:none}}
/* hero */
.hero{position:relative;color:#fff;min-height:min(80vh,760px);display:grid;align-items:end;overflow:hidden;background:var(--dark)}
.hero.short{min-height:min(58vh,540px)}
.hero img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 70%}
.hero::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(14,26,22,.1) 0%,rgba(14,26,22,.35) 45%,rgba(14,26,22,.94) 100%)}
.hero .wrap{position:relative;z-index:1;padding-block:56px 44px;display:grid;gap:18px}
.hero p{color:#dbe5df;font-size:1.2rem;max-width:60ch}
.hero .cta{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.hero .eyebrow{color:#9ad99d}
/* router */
.router{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:18px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1.4fr 1fr auto;gap:12px;align-items:end;margin-top:-34px;position:relative;z-index:2}
@media (max-width:860px){.router{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media (max-width:520px){.router{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.router .btn{height:46px}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(160px,1fr));gap:1px;background:var(--line);border:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:22px}
.stat{background:var(--bg2);padding:18px 18px 16px}
.stat .n{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:900;font-size:2.2rem;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--blue-ink)}
.stat .l{font-size:.92rem;color:var(--ink2)}
/* tiles */
.tiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:18px}
.tile{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-rows:190px auto;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);text-decoration:none;color:inherit;overflow:hidden;border-radius:6px}
.tile img{width:100%;height:190px;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .3s ease}
.tile:hover img{transform:scale(1.04)}
.tile .t{padding:16px 18px 20px;display:grid;gap:8px}
.tile .t span{color:var(--ink2);font-size:.95rem}
.tile .t em{font-style:normal;color:var(--blue-ink);font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700;font-size:.9rem}
.cols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:40px;align-items:center}
.cols>*{min-width:0}
.cols.top{align-items:start}
@media (max-width:820px){.cols{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.photo{border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:4/3;max-width:100%;background:var(--line)}
.photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.photo.wide{aspect-ratio:16/9}
.steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:26px}
.step{display:grid;gap:8px;padding-top:14px;border-top:3px solid var(--green);align-content:start}
.step small{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700;color:var(--green-ink);letter-spacing:.1em;font-size:.75rem}
.band.dark .step small{color:var(--green)}
.facts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(250px,1fr));gap:22px 36px}
.fact h3{margin-bottom:6px}
.fact p{color:var(--ink2)}
ul.plain{margin:0;padding-left:20px;display:grid;gap:6px}
ul.check{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:10px}
ul.check li{padding-left:28px;position:relative}
ul.check li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:.45em;width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green)}
ul.check li::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:5px;top:.45em;width:4px;height:9px;border:solid #fff;border-width:0 2.5px 2.5px 0;transform:translateY(1px) rotate(45deg)}
.tbl{overflow-x:auto}
table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:.97rem}
th,td{text-align:left;padding:10px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);vertical-align:top}
th{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink2)}
.wall{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(160px,1fr));gap:12px}
.wall div{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:16px 12px;text-align:center;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700;color:var(--ink2);font-size:.9rem;background:var(--bg2)}
.streams{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:12px}
.streams div{border-left:3px solid var(--blue);padding:10px 14px;background:var(--bg2)}
.streams b{display:block;font-family:var(--display);font-size:.95rem}
.streams span{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--ink2)}
/* team */
.people{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:18px}
.person{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:18px 20px;display:grid;gap:6px;align-content:start}
.person small{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700;font-size:.8rem;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--green-ink)}
.person p{color:var(--ink2);font-size:.95rem}
.photos{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:12px}
.photos .photo{aspect-ratio:4/3}
.photos .photo.tallp{aspect-ratio:3/4}
.photos .photo.wide{aspect-ratio:2/1;grid-column:span 2}
@media (max-width:520px){.photos .photo.wide{grid-column:span 1}}
/* forms */
.form{display:grid;gap:14px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:24px;border-radius:6px}
.form .row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
@media (max-width:620px){.form .row{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
label{display:grid;gap:5px;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink2)}
input,select,textarea{font:inherit;padding:11px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:4px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);width:100%;min-width:0}
textarea{min-height:110px;resize:vertical}
.ok{display:none;padding:14px;border-left:4px solid var(--green);background:var(--bg)}
.ok.show{display:block}
.chk{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;font-weight:500}
.chk input{width:auto}
/* cases */
.cases{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:20px}
.case{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:22px;display:grid;gap:10px;align-content:start}
.case .big{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:900;font-size:2.4rem;letter-spacing:-.02em;color:var(--blue-ink);line-height:1;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.case .big small{display:block;font-size:.85rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--green-ink);margin-top:6px}
.case p{color:var(--ink2);font-size:.97rem}
.case .who{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--ink)}
.quotes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:22px}
.q{padding:20px;border-left:3px solid var(--blue);background:var(--bg2)}
.q p{font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--ink)}
.q small{display:block;margin-top:10px;color:var(--ink2);font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700}
/* doc card */
.doc{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:22px;font-size:.95rem;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.doc::before{content:"SPECIMEN";position:absolute;right:-30px;top:18px;transform:rotate(30deg);font-family:var(--display);font-weight:900;color:var(--line);font-size:1.6rem;letter-spacing:.2em}
.doc h4{font-size:1rem;margin-bottom:10px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}
.doc dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:max-content 1fr;gap:6px 16px;margin:0}
.doc dt{color:var(--ink2)}.doc dd{margin:0;font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
/* ban checker */
.checker{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:22px;display:grid;gap:14px}
.checker .row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr auto;gap:12px;align-items:end}
@media (max-width:620px){.checker .row{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.verdict{padding:14px 16px;border-left:4px solid var(--blue);background:var(--bg);font-size:1.02rem}
.verdict.yes{border-color:#c0392b}.verdict.no{border-color:var(--green)}
/* page header */
.ph .wrap{display:grid;gap:12px;padding-block:clamp(40px,6vw,72px) clamp(24px,4vw,40px)}
footer{background:var(--dark);color:var(--dark-ink2);padding-block:48px 32px;font-size:.95rem}
footer .grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:30px}
@media (max-width:820px){footer .grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media (max-width:520px){footer .grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
footer h4{color:#fff;font-size:.85rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:10px}
footer a{color:var(--dark-ink);text-decoration:none}
footer a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
footer ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:6px}
.copy{margin-top:30px;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid #223129;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;font-size:.85rem}
.copybtn{background:none;border:1px solid #3a4a44;color:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:3px 8px;font:inherit;font-size:.8rem;cursor:pointer;margin-left:6px}
.page{display:none}.page.on{display:block}
.fn{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--ink2)}
.band.dark .fn{color:var(--dark-ink2)}
.kicker{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700;color:var(--blue-ink)}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}}
</style>

<div class="notes" id="notes"><strong>Draft notes (not for publication).</strong> Every figure below is either from Samsara/CRM/known facts or a stated derivation. Confirm or correct:
<ul>
<li><b>~45,000 tons</b> — derived: 24 organics route trucks × ~6.5 t/day × 250 days ≈ 39k, plus destruction and liquid streams. Replace with Routeware August × 12. Now labeled as last-twelve-months scale/route records.</li>
<li><b>Case-study specifics</b> (districts of 20–40 stores, 25 pallets / 14,400 units / 3 lots, ~40 loads over 9 business days, ~60,000 gal/week, 0.4% residual on the specimen certificate) are drafted to be specific; replace with the real job figures.</li>
<li><b>Residual rate reporting</b> — site now promises residual fractions on statements and certificates. Confirm the statement template can show it.</li>
<li><b>50+ trucks</b> — Samsara: 24 organics route trucks, 12 tractors, 7 roll-offs, 2 tankers, plus rentals. Your instruction: say 50+.</li>
<li><b>357 stores / 5 states</b> grocery rollout — from the ADUSA model. Case study is anonymous.</li>
<li><b>24-hour certificate turnaround</b>, <b>same-business-day destruction quote</b>, <b>7-year video archive</b>, <b>two-business-day quotes</b> — service promises I drafted to beat the benchmark. Confirm ops can hold them or I soften.</li>
<li><b>Container sizes</b> (64-gal carts, 2–8 yd, 20–40 yd roll-offs), <b>tanker gallonage</b> (5,000–6,000 gal) — standard spec; confirm against the actual fleet.</li>
<li>Case-study figures marked <b>~</b> (loads, days, tons) are illustrative placeholders for you to replace with real numbers from the jobs.</li>
<li>State ban thresholds are current to my knowledge (MA ½ t/wk Nov 2022; RI 1 t/wk 2024; CT 26 t/yr; VT universal; NH 1 t/wk Feb 2025; NY 2 t/wk; NJ 52 t/yr). Re-verify before launch.</li>
<li>Testimonials are the three already on the live site, lightly trimmed.</li>
<li><b>December 2025 fire</b>: About page states collection continued and processing ran through contingency outlets while equipment was replaced. Confirm the facts and dates before launch.</li>
<li><b>Customer service promises</b> (same-day recovery before 2pm, statements by the 10th, arrival-window texts, 7-year record retention, portal in development) are drafted targets. Confirm or soften.</li>
<li><b>2023 sustainability award</b> is on the old site; confirm the issuing body for the About page.</li>
<li><b>Fleet model year</b>: Samsara shows most units 2022 or newer.</li>
</ul></div>

<main>

<!-- ================= HOME ================= -->
<section class="page" id="p-home">
  <div class="hero">
    <img src="/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/rwi-gen2-hero-sunset.jpg" alt="Recycleworks organics truck at the end of a route">
    <div class="wrap">
      <span class="eyebrow">Food &amp; beverage waste · New England, New York, New Jersey</span>
      <h1>Food and beverage waste collection and recycling</h1>
      <p>Recycleworks collects and recycles organic waste for supermarkets, food producers, beverage brands and institutions across New England, New York and New Jersey, and destroys and recycles beverage product at our own facility in Braintree. We run our own trucks, so the company that picks up your material is the one that sends you the weight ticket.</p>
      <div class="cta">
        <a class="btn primary" href="#quote">Get a quote</a>
        <a class="btn ghost" href="#compliance">Am I covered by a food-waste ban?</a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="wrap">
    <form class="router" id="router" novalidate aria-label="Quick start">
      <label>Site ZIP <input id="r-zip" inputmode="numeric" placeholder="02184"></label>
      <label>What do you need handled? <select id="r-svc"><option value="organics">Food waste pickup (carts, totes, dumpsters)</option><option value="commercial">Packaged or bulk food, trailer loads, roll-offs</option><option value="destruction">Beverage product destruction</option><option value="liquid">Liquid waste by tanker</option><option value="solutions">Multi-site program / reporting / other</option></select></label>
      <label>Business type <select id="r-type"><option>Supermarket / grocery</option><option>Food or beverage manufacturer</option><option>Distributor / cold storage / 3PL</option><option>Restaurant / hospitality</option><option>Hospital / university / school</option><option>Municipality</option><option>Other</option></select></label>
      <button class="btn primary" type="submit">Start</button>
    </form>
    <div class="stats" aria-label="Key figures">
      <div class="stat"><div class="n">30+</div><div class="l">years operating in Massachusetts; founded in Braintree</div></div>
      <div class="stat"><div class="n">50+</div><div class="l">trucks in service: route trucks, tractors, roll-offs and tankers, company-owned (fleet telematics count)</div></div>
      <div class="stat"><div class="n">~45,000</div><div class="l">tons of organics handled in the last twelve months (scale and route records)</div></div>
      <div class="stat"><div class="n">0</div><div class="l">tons sent to landfill by design; residual rates reported on each customer statement</div></div>
      <div class="stat"><div class="n">2022+</div><div class="l">model year for the majority of route trucks (fleet records)</div></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="band">
    <div class="wrap stack">
      <span class="eyebrow">Five divisions, one dispatch</span>
      <h2>Five divisions</h2>
